item.title: Changes to carer’s benefits payments proposed
item.description: CHANGES which would allow a full home carers’ allowance and a pension to be claimed at the same time could be made in 2028, if States Members agree. Last year, the JEP launched its #TimeToCare campaign after Islander Mark Jones spoke out against the overlapping benefits law. item.description: POLICE are appealing for witnesses to a crash in Grouville which happened on Saturday afternoon. item.title: Kezia’s Fund opens for new round of grant applications
item.description: A FUND set up to honour the memory of a young Islander who took her own life has opened for applications to support mental-health initiatives for children and young people in Jersey. item.title: Man convicted of rapes and assault of teenage girls
item.description: A MAN has been convicted of a string of historic sexual offences against teenage girls by a Royal Court Jury. item.title: Petty Debts Court orders Happy Hooves operator to pay back more than £1,200
item.description: The operator of a Jersey equestrian centre which recently had its horses and other animals seized has been ordered to pay more than £1,200 following a judgment in the Petty Debts Court.
